criteria.text: The README "OpenSandbox cells" section lists the evidence push as a numbered step before `OPENSANDBOX_URL`, and the renewal rule.

evidence.name: the README pushes the evidence as a numbered step before OPENSANDBOX_URL, with the renewal rule

criteria.text: The timer runs on the box, pushes fresh evidence, and the newest evidence's `expires_at` moves forward (shown by a read-only query).

defer.when: after merge: install-opensandbox.sh on automata-exec-1, systemctl start automata-cell-evidence.service, then the read-only profile_evidence query shows expires_at moved forward (main session, before 2026-12-12)

criteria.text: The timer skips (and logs why) when a cell run is live.

evidence.name: skips with a logged reason while a cell or a hand-run IT is up, before the IT runs

criteria.text: With evidence expiring within 7 days, the alert fires once (no duplicate issue while one is open); with fresh evidence it does not.
No secret appears in the timer's journal or the alert.

evidence.name: never prints the secret, the API key or the IT output, and never exports the secret
